title: Script file frontmatter (first line of map/triggers/**/*.j, .vjass, .lua)
description: The JSON after `// @w3proj` (JASS) or `-- @w3proj` (Lua) on the first line of a custom-text trigger or script item (docs/trigger-folders-spec.md, section 3B), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/trigger_layout.rs. A file without that line is a trigger or script item made outside Studio. Unknown keys are errors there, so they are refused here too. Editors can't apply this schema to a comment line; the test checks it.

type.description: 8 a custom-text trigger, 32 a script item (Reforged)

isCustom.description: true when missing; only a script item (type 32) can be false

ecas.description: what an imported item carries beside its text, kept; none when missing

text.description: a name or value war3map.wtg stores: no zero character
